features.title: Step 3: the second brain on the owner's PC (assistant by default)
criteria: The second brain's key goes only to the owner's tailnet; without the key or in mode off it is never called; its answers are untrusted data validated by code and it has no tool

A VPS-owned queue with priorities, dedupe keys, validity windows and leases: a PC that stops mid-task loses nothing, the first valid answer wins, Claude never waits, an outage over 2 hours is an incident

Assistant mode (default): the PC reads first among the readers, triages news (shadow wakes, capped), writes situation notes shown at wakes, argues against open positions, gathers post-mortem facts, answers /question by Telegram

Parallel mode scores the second brain's own probabilities against Claude's by code; each answer records the model the PC serves and the evidence (parallel score, delegation gate, confirmation at 50 tasks with under one failure in ten) counts only that model; delegation is refused until 100 are scored within 0.01 of Claude's Brier

On the owner's PC a supervisor runs llama-server on 127.0.0.1 with the key file, restarts it when it stops, pauses on a flag file and reads optional model and options files; sonni/GUIDE-PC.fr.md takes the owner from Windows settings to /cerveau through Tailscale serve, with a grants policy limiting the VPS to that one port

features.title: Trade results, win rate and decision profitability count every fee
criteria: WHEN a trade is read, THE SYSTEM SHALL report its result after the purchase fee share and the sale fee, so that a full round trip's result equals cash received minus cash spent (within one cent for assets priced well above 1 EUR; below that, cent-rounded fill and average prices can widen the gap), and its % on the lot's cost including the purchase fee

THE SYSTEM SHALL count a trade as won only when that result is above zero, and SHALL average trade % on those results; /portefeuille, /bilan, the evening summary, notebooks, the day/week/month summaries, the pack and the consistency check's facts SHALL show the same figures

WHEN an open position is valued or partly sold, THE SYSTEM SHALL count the purchase fees it still carries (its buys' fees minus the shares booked to its earlier sales), so that the purchase shares of a position's trades add up to its buy fees in any order of buys and sales, while equity and the portfolio result (equity minus contributions) stay exactly as before

WHEN decisions are scored, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep 'right side' as the direction of the move, SHALL count a buy or add as profitable and a rise after staying out as a missed gain only beyond the market round-trip break-even move computed from the configured fees and slippage, and SHALL read the 7-day scores of the self-report and /bilan on decisions whose 7-day horizon has passed (made 7 to 14 days ago)
Tests SHALL cover gains, losses, fees, small moves, moves at and around break-even for trades and decisions, partial sales, a buy after a partial sale, the 7-day window and stored rows
Stored trades, orders, ledger rows and decisions are never rewritten (append-only); the recorded pnl_eur keeps its meaning and the correction is applied when reading
Fills, cash, equity, the portfolio result, order caps, stops, lesson scoring and every trading rule are unchanged; no paid call

bug.current: A closed trade's result left out its purchase fee (avg_cost = fill price), so per-trade P&L, win rate and mean trade % read about 0.8 % of the stake too high; an open position's result left out its purchase fee; decisions counted any rise after staying out as a missed gain, even one too small to pay a round trip's fees

implementation.note: Trades read after every fee (purchase share subtracted at read time from fees_eur minus the sale order's fee; stored rows untouched). Sales book the purchase fees the position still carries (buys' fees minus shares already booked), so a buy after a partial sale is shared right. Open positions subtract the fees they carry; equity unchanged. Decisions: market round-trip break-even 1.7211 % for profitable buys and missed gains; 7-day scores read on decisions made 7 to 14 days ago. Labels after fees in status, report, notebooks, pack, soul, summaries, brainchecks, index; e2e expectation updated. Mutation checks: 10 reverts each fail the tests.
